A comprehensive Catholic examination of conscience compiled according to the Tractatus de sacramento poenitentiae. Note: confession online is never valid.

This confession window is not approved by any ecclesiastical authority and has not been censored. When the examination is generated no data is placed or stored on the server; it is readable solely from your browser's cookie, so once that is cleared the data is removed.
Not censored, not proofread, use at your own responsibility. If you find errors or have improvements, please write to the email given in the info section / site administrator (click).
